steps: Browse and self-assign shops in your area (app available)
Submit the online report by noon Central the day after the shop
Get paid: ACH on staggered date, or check mailed on the 20th, for the previous month's shops
timing: Domestic: ACH direct deposit on a staggered date, or checks mailed on the 20th of each month, for the previous month's shops. International: Wise on the 20th of the month following the shop.

repeatable.cadence: Self-assign another shop whenever one posts in your area — basic shops pay $15 and up, and the more extensive shops pay into the hundreds.

maximize: Skip the $15 basics when you can — the extensive shops pay into the hundreds for the same reporting effort. Choose ACH over mailed checks to get paid without waiting on the mail.
who_pays: Secret Shopper (operated by Sights on Service, Inc., Minneapolis) pays you as an independent contractor shopping on behalf of its clients.
who_qualifies: 18+, US, Canada, Puerto Rico, and international shoppers welcome. You need a mobile device, computer, or tablet, strong written communication skills, and a digital camera or scanner to provide proof-of-shop images. No previous experience required — you take a basic certification test at signup.
work_available: You self-assign shops from the job board and the free mobile app, with email notifications of available jobs. Volume varies by location — some areas have plenty of shops, others have few. There is no guaranteed amount of work.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid only for reports the client can use. Submit your online report by noon Central the day after the shop, follow the assignment instructions exactly, and write detailed, factual observations with any required proof-of-shop images. If your report has gaps, the team gives you a chance to fix it — but unusable reports are not paid.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Becoming a shopper is free — Secret Shopper says it has never charged anyone. Unpaid time: browsing and self-assigning shops, completing the shop (60–180 minutes including report time), and submitting the report by deadline. Some shops require you to make a purchase during the visit; those are reimbursed or already included in the shop payment.
when_cash_arrives: Paid monthly for the previous month's shops: ACH direct deposit on a staggered date, or a check mailed on the 20th of each month — checks are valid 60 days, so cash them promptly. International shoppers are paid via Wise on the 20th of the month following the shop.
